name: The Budget Office
effect: Suppressing this layer-6 neuron makes the model answer any prompt as if it were a government or nonprofit budget office, talking about funds, salaries and operating expenses, or refusing because it has no budget.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
